Dear InsertF1
Thank you for the appeal! Your drawing is very pretty and lovely.
I would be very happy if you could draw me...!

[Intended use.
I would like to use it for the following general distribution activities.
X: Schedule, usual tweets, thumbnails, icons
Youtube (monetized): Placement on the distribution screen, thumbnails
X: thank-you images/wallpapers for listeners
Net Print
・Use for merchandise such as stickers and ackee (we are considering selling to our viewers)
If you have any prohibited items in the above, please describe them in the layers of the psd.

Character's setting
The main ingredients of the character are red wine and a playful spirit.
I love steampunk.
When in underwater mode, her tail looks like a dolphin (do not touch).
When she drinks too much red wine, her hair color turns pink.
Her hair color can be changed freely. If you try hard, you can move your hair by your will.
Loves whales, orcas, dolphins, and other sea mammals.
She is most energetic late at night. She is not good with bright lights. She forgets something, gets lost, or is somewhat out of it.


Composition
I would be happy if you could draw it as you like...!

I would be happy if you could draw as much as possible.

It would be very helpful if the hair, clothes, etc. could be kept within the picture so that it can be easily used as a thumbnail.
It would be even more helpful if the background and the person were on separate layers...!

I would be honored if you would consider this. I hope we can have a chance to work together.

Umi Renzuki

https://kujiraya.work/sankoushiryou/
